[center][b][font=Georgia][color=#93c47d][size=6]Nature In The Valley[/size][/color][/font][/b][/center]
[font=Georgia][size=3]This is a gameplay expansion mod which﻿ adds 84 animals as semi-randomly spawning interactive creatures, along with systems like a new net tool to catch and sell these creatures, or donate them to the new Insectarium building. This mod also adds Terrariums to keep creatures as pets!. Includes a framework for other mods to make their own creatures/animals! This was heavily based upon Animal Crossing, and so many features of bugs from Animal Crossing carry over to animals in Nature In The Valley.[/size]

﻿  ﻿  ﻿[/font]
[center][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][color=#93c47d][size=6]﻿Animals[/size][/color][/font][/font][/center]
[font=Georgia][size=3]Animals will spawn according to time of day, location, weather, and the types of objects in your current location (Trees, bushes, water, stumps). A new net tool bought from The Insectarium, Pierre's or JojaMart is used to catch the animals[/size]. [size=3]Some animals will run away from you if you move too close to them, some wont care about your movement, and a few will actively hunt you! Some animals fly, some hop around, some lounge on trees and bushes and some are found on the surface of the water! The encyclopedia in the insectarium features a full infographic list of the creatures found and yet to be discovered, from this you can also enable or disable the spawning of specific donatable creatures if that is your wish (You can also directly change this list in the FilteredSpawns file). You can also find a full list of creatures at the bottom of this page (SPOILERS!). 

When a creature is dropped directly from your inventory, it will be released. A released creature stays around until the end of the day.[/size][/font]

[center][font=Georgia][color=#93c47d][size=6]Insectarium[/size][/color][/font][/center]
[font=Georgia][size=3]Re-imagined by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/omena007/mods?gameId=1303ttp://]omena007[/url] in update 1.3.1, the insectarium is a new building accessed by a ticket machine from the bus stop, and can be reached prior to the bus stop being fixed. The insectarium has a slight story behind it, and some lore - featuring a new NPC Ivy. Animals donated to the insectarium will wander around a specific room / location which resonates with where you found them. Once you've donated some creatures, it'll become quite the lively place, with butterflies, beetles, frogs and countless other creatures all around you! As creatures are donated you'll also receive specific milestone rewards similar to the museum. Additionally, the more creatures are donated the more decorated the insectarium becomes! A major feature of the insectarium is the creature encyclopedia, a infographical menu for you to find out more about the habits of each creature. Images showing a fresh and completed Insectarium can be seen in the media tab (SPOILERS!)

The insectarium contains 3 events, and a shop!

If you use Central Station the ticket machine for the insectarium will be removed, and the insectarium will be added as a stop to the central station ticket machine.[/size]

[size=3]There is an optional file for players with the [url=https://github.com/Xytronix/BusLocations/releases/tag/1.2.2]Bus Locations[/url] mod, when both that file and the Bus Locations mod is installed it will remove the warp totem spot at the bus stop, and will instead use the normal bus stop totem. If you have any issue with other mods introducing NPCs which path-find into the warp, use the optional file and the Bus Locations mod.[/size][/font]

[center][font=Georgia][size=3][color=#93c47d][size=6]Terrariums[/size][/color][/size][/font][/center]
[left][font=Georgia][size=3]Talking to ivy gives the option to get Terrariums of creatures which you have already donated. (She needs to know what they need to survive before making a portable home for them!). These terrariums are animated furniture, each creature (custom or from the base game) will auto generate a terrarium for them based on their spawning and living conditions.

There is a config option to give terrariums opaque backgrounds (wallpapers) rather than being see through.

Examples of terrariums can be seen in the mod media page.[/size][/font][/left]

[center][font=Georgia][size=3][color=#93c47d][size=6]Framework[/size][/color][/size][/font][/center]
[font=Georgia][size=3]This mod itself is also a framework. Separate mods can be made as content packs for Nature In The Valley to add custom creatures with their own behaviors and sprites to the game. These creatures would be seen at the end of the encyclopedia. Included in the optional files section of this page is an example content pack using content patcher for this mod, showing how to add custom creatures. Using this same feature, you can also replace the base version of creatures with custom ones by using the same name.

[center][font=Georgia][color=#93c47d][size=5]Configuration[/size][/color][/font][/center]
[font=Georgia][size=3]This mod includes five configuration options for changing the relative spawn rate, max density, sell price of the creatures, a multiplier for the size of the catching net and a toggle for including creatures in the shipping collection. These can be accessed via Generic Mod Config Menu or your config file in [GEN]NatureInTheValley/NatureInTheValley/config.json. There is also a config option for a keybind to open the creature encyclopedia from anywhere, a config option for the range of creatures, a config option for the size of creatures, a config option for whether terrariums have wallpapers, a config option to include the charge sound effect for the net, and a config option to use only content pack creatures. Note that this wont always display an accurate account of donated creatures for multiplayer players. [/size]

If you have multiple content packs for Nature In The Valley installed and only want to see / include creatures from the content packs (not base mod) then there is also a config option for that. Reload after changing! This will also remove the base mod's insectarium rewards.[/font]


[center][font=Georgia][color=#93c47d][size=5]Translations[/size][/color][/font][/center]
[font=Georgia][size=3]This mod includes two i18n files for translations; if you'd like to you can send me a translated version of the i18n file in your native language and I will add it to the main file, and give you credit for the translation here. Please do not reupload this mod in alternate languages without it depending on this mod page. [/size]

If you've given a translation and an update has occurred, text which still requires true translation will be unindented in the i18n file.
Many of these translations do need updates, so if you speak that language feel free to send me an updated version (if you want).

[center][font=Georgia][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/font][/center]
[font=Georgia][size=3]This mod is [b]fully compatible with online multiplayer and SVE[/b], it currently does not have any listed incompatible mods.[/size][/font]
[font=Georgia][size=3]
Multiplayer is fully compatible. Creature lists are NOT SYNCED, so each player will see/find their own creatures! Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39568]NITV Multiplayer Support[/url] by XanCreations if this piques your interest, as I will likely not be adding this for some time.[/size][/font]
[font=Georgia][size=3]
There are unique / extra compatibility features added to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5559]Jade[/url] npc mod.

This mod includes an [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11026]Iconic Framework[/url] button to open the creature encyclopedia.

This mod includes an [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21286]Informant Mod[/url] compat for creatures not yet donated.[/size][/font][/*]
[*]This mod has built-in support for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16205]Stardew Access[/url]! Creatures can be navigated via the object finder in stardew access, under their own tab "Creatures"! This tab doesn't auto-update but can be manually updated by pressing whatever hotkey is used for switching between alphabetical and nearest sorting in stardew access. So when you want the creature list updated, double-tap it. In tandem with this, clicking "donate" or "make terrariums" at the insectarium will auto-donate or convert all valid creatures in your inventory if you are using Stardew Access.
[font=Georgia][size=3]
This mod has built in compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8000]Central Station[/url] which adds the Insectarium as a stop, while removing the separate Ticket Machine.[/size][/font]
